# Modular MEP Solutions

> MENASCO's modular MEP capability delivers complete mechanical, electrical and plumbing assemblies as factory-built units, produced in controlled manufacturing environments before arriving on site. From prefabricated plant skids to modular data-center whitespace solutions, our modular approach reduces on-site installation time while maintaining the same engineering standards applied across every MENASCO project.
